dialogs.applyBody: {{description}}{{tradeoff}} Compy snapshots the prior state so you can undo this from Applied.
dialogs.rollbackBody: Compy restores the setting to how it was before.{{dest}}
dialogs.rollbackKeptOutside: You chose to keep “{{kept}}”, set outside Compy. Rolling back switches your power plan to “{{saved}}”, the plan Compy saved before it changed anything, away from “{{kept}}”.
dialogs.rollbackKeptOutsideSame: You chose to keep “{{kept}}”, set outside Compy. Rolling back switches your power plan to the plan Compy saved before it changed anything, which is “{{kept}}” too, so your plan stays the same.
dialogs.rollbackKeptOutsideUnnamed: You chose to keep “{{kept}}”, set outside Compy. Rolling back switches your power plan to the plan Compy saved before it changed anything (Compy didn't save its name), away from “{{kept}}”.
dialogs.rollbackManyBody: {{total}} records of this setting are not undone yet. Undoing it undoes each of them, newest first: each puts back what Compy saved just before that record's change, so the oldest record is undone last. If this setting needs administrator rights, Windows asks for permission once for each record. It stops at the first one that does not finish or that you decline.
dialogs.rollbackOneOutOfOrder: An older record of this setting was undone before this one, so this record's saved value may be one Compy set. Compy undoes one record at a time here.
dialogs.rollbackOneTrial: A Trial is in progress (or Compy can't tell), so Compy undoes one record of this setting at a time here.
dialogs.rollbackOneUnread: Compy couldn't read its change list, so it undoes only this record here.
dialogs.rollbackOneNoSavedUndo: One record of this setting has no saved undo, so Compy undoes one record at a time here.

errors.recoverGamingFailed: Couldn't finish restoring your settings just now — try again, or use Review.
errors.gamingResumeFailedGround: Your settings were restored, but Gaming Mode couldn't start again — turn it on from the {{room}} when you're ready.
errors.gamingResumeLeftChanged: Your last session was restored, but the new one didn't start cleanly — some of its changes may still be on this PC. Use Restore now to put them back.
errors.gamingResumeFailedMerged: Your settings were restored, but Gaming Mode couldn't start again — turn it on from {{room}} when you're ready.
errors.exportFailed: Couldn't build the report just now — try again in a moment.
errors.readInfoFailed: Couldn't read some of your system info just now — try again in a moment.
errors.rankPrioritiesFailed: Couldn't rank your priorities just now — try again in a moment.
errors.startupToggleFailed: Couldn't change that startup item just now — try again.
errors.applyFailed: Couldn't apply that change — it may need an admin OK, or the prompt was cancelled. Nothing was changed; try again.
errors.rollbackFailed: Couldn't undo that change just now — try again, or undo it from the Trust Ledger.
errors.noSavedUndo: Compy has no saved undo for "{{title}}" (its record doesn't say how to put it back). Nothing was changed.
errors.recAppliedExternally: "{{title}}" is currently on but Compy didn't apply it, so there's no rollback record. Toggle it off in the original Windows location instead.
errors.undoPartialFailed: {{title}}: {{done}} of {{total}} records undone. Compy stopped at one it couldn't undo; the rest are still in your change history.
errors.undoPartialUnrecorded: {{title}}: {{done}} of {{total}} records undone, and one more ran on Windows but couldn't be saved to your change history. Compy stopped there.

backendErrors.taskUnreadable: Compy couldn't check this Windows task right now (the check couldn't run or Windows didn't answer in time), so nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.
backendErrors.taskNotFound: That telemetry task isn't on this PC, so there is nothing to turn off.
backendErrors.taskUnreadableUndo: Compy couldn't check this Windows task right now, so it wasn't turned back on yet. The change stays in your Trust Ledger so you can try again.
backendErrors.taskNotFoundUndo: Compy couldn't find that telemetry task on this PC any more, so it couldn't turn it back on. The change stays in your Trust Ledger.
backendErrors.taskNameRefused: Compy found that telemetry task, but its name has characters Compy won't put into a Windows command, so nothing was changed.
backendErrors.taskNameRefusedUndo: Compy found that telemetry task, but its name has characters Compy won't put into a Windows command, so it wasn't turned back on. The change stays in your Trust Ledger.
backendErrors.eeeUnreadable: Compy couldn't read your network adapters right now (the check couldn't run or Windows didn't answer in time), so nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.
backendErrors.eeeNoAdapter: No connected wired network adapter on this PC offers an Energy-Efficient Ethernet setting, so there is nothing to change.
backendErrors.eeeNoSwitch: Your adapter's driver has an Energy-Efficient Ethernet setting, but no value Compy recognizes as off, so Compy left it as it is rather than guess.
backendErrors.eeeUnreadReason: Couldn't check Energy-Efficient Ethernet on your wired adapter right now.
backendErrors.drivesUnreadReason: Only for HDD-only systems — Compy couldn't list this rig's drives.
backendErrors.eeeValueRefused: Compy found your adapter's Energy-Efficient Ethernet setting, but its details contain characters Compy won't put into a Windows command, so nothing was changed.
backendErrors.eeeValueRefusedUndo: Compy found this change's saved adapter details, but they contain characters Compy won't put into a Windows command, so it didn't run the undo. The change stays in your Trust Ledger.
backendErrors.trialHoldsSetting: A setting this action changes is being tested by a Trial right now, so Compy won't run it on top of the test. Let the Trial finish, or end it with Restore now in Test, first. Nothing was changed.
backendErrors.trialStartInterrupted: An earlier Trial start of a setting this action changes was interrupted and isn't resolved yet, so Compy won't run it now. Check Test → Applied & history, then try again. Nothing was changed.
backendErrors.benchHoldsSetting: A setting this action changes is being measured by the benchmark right now, so Compy won't run it on top of the measurement. Wait until the benchmark finishes and puts its change back, or cancel it. Nothing was changed.
backendErrors.baselineMissing: The baseline session isn't in your session history any more. Play a monitored session, then try again.
backendErrors.baselineAmbiguous: Two sessions in your history share that baseline's start time, so Compy can't tell which one to use.
backendErrors.baselineBehind: The baseline session measured nothing: another window was in front the whole time. Play a session with the game in front, then try again.
backendErrors.baselineNoReading: The baseline session has no frame-rate reading, so there's nothing to compare the change against.
backendErrors.baselineNoGame: The baseline session didn't record which game was running, so there's no game to measure the change in.
backendErrors.treatmentNoBaselineRef: This Trial was started before Compy kept a reference to its baseline session, so the before and after can't be checked. Restore it and start a new one.
backendErrors.treatmentIsBaseline: The session picked as the after-reading is the baseline itself.
backendErrors.treatmentBaselineGone: The baseline session is no longer in your session history, so the before and after can't be checked. Restore the Trial and start a new one.
backendErrors.treatmentMissing: That session isn't in your session history. Play a monitored session of this game, then conclude.
backendErrors.treatmentAmbiguous: Two sessions in your history share that start time, so Compy can't tell which one to judge.
backendErrors.treatmentBehind: That session measured nothing: another window was in front the whole time. Play a session of this game with the game in front, then conclude.
backendErrors.treatmentNoReading: That session has no frame-rate reading to judge.
backendErrors.treatmentNoGame: That session didn't record which game was running, so Compy can't confirm it measured this game.
backendErrors.treatmentNoApplyTime: This Trial didn't record when its change took effect, so no session can be shown to have been played after it. Restore it and start a new one.
backendErrors.treatmentCantTellAfter: Compy can't tell whether that session was played after the change was applied, so it can't be the after-reading.
backendErrors.treatmentPlayedBefore: That session was played before the change was applied, so it can't measure it. Play a new session of this game, then conclude.
backendErrors.treatmentNotComparable: The two sessions aren't comparable: a recorded condition differs between them. Play a session of this game under the same conditions as the baseline, or restore the Trial.
backendErrors.treatmentComparabilityUnknown: The two sessions don't share any recorded rig or conditions, so Compy can't check they're comparable. Restore the Trial and start a new one.
backendErrors.abortNotChanged: The setting did not read as changed after the apply, so there was nothing to measure.
backendErrors.abortUnreadable: Compy could not read the setting back after the apply, so it can't show the change took effect.
backendErrors.trialRecordNotSaved: Compy could not save this Trial's record.
backendErrors.abortRestored: Compy stopped this Trial before measuring and put the change back.
backendErrors.abortAlreadyReverted: Compy stopped this Trial before measuring; the change had already been undone outside Compy.
backendErrors.restoreNotCompleted: Compy tried to put the change back, but the restore did not complete, so Compy can't confirm the change was undone. Check it in Test → Applied & history and undo it there.
backendErrors.restoredStillReadsChanged: Compy put the change back, but a read afterwards still shows the setting as changed; something else may have set it again. Check it in Test → Applied & history.
backendErrors.undoneOutsideReadsChanged: The change was already undone outside Compy, but a read now shows the setting as changed again; something else is setting it. Check it in Test → Applied & history.
backendErrors.applyErrReadsUnchanged: The apply reported an error. The setting reads as not changed, but a change that stopped part-way can read that way too, and Compy saved no undo record for it. If it looks changed in Windows, set it back there.
backendErrors.applyErrReadsChanged: The apply reported an error, and the setting now reads as changed. Compy saved no undo record for it, so it can't undo it and it won't be listed in Test → Applied & history. Set it back in Windows.
backendErrors.applyErrUnreadable: The apply reported an error, and Compy can't read the setting to tell whether it changed. Compy saved no undo record for it. Check the setting in Windows.
backendErrors.benchRolledBackUnrecorded: Measurement finished and the change was rolled back, but Compy couldn't save that undo to its history, so Test → Applied & history may still list the change as applied.
backendErrors.benchRollbackFailed: Measurement finished, but Compy tried to roll the change back and the rollback failed, so Compy can't confirm it was undone. Check it in Test → Applied & history and undo it there.
backendErrors.benchStackRollbackFailed: Measurement finished, but Compy tried to roll the changes back and one or more rollbacks failed, so Compy can't confirm they were all undone. Check them in Test → Applied & history and undo them there.
backendErrors.benchStackRolledBackUnrecorded: The changes were measured and rolled back, but Compy couldn't save some of those undos to its history, so Test → Applied & history may still list them as applied.
backendErrors.benchLedgerUnreadBefore: Compy couldn't read its change history before measuring, so it changed nothing. Try again when it can be read.
backendErrors.benchLedgerUnreadAfter: The changes were applied, but Compy couldn't re-read its change history to roll them back automatically. Undo them in Test → Applied & history.
backendErrors.powerSettingIdRefused: This change's saved power plan setting isn't in the form Compy expects, so Compy didn't run the undo. The change stays in your Trust Ledger.
backendErrors.powerPlanIdRefusedUndo: This change's saved power plan isn't in the form Compy expects, so Compy didn't switch back to it. The change stays in your Trust Ledger.
backendErrors.settingUnread: Compy couldn't read this setting right now, so it can't say whether it is on or off.
backendErrors.gmBusy: Compy is still finishing another change or a Gaming Mode start (if a Windows permission prompt is open, answer or cancel it) — give it a second and try again
backendErrors.gmHoldsSetting: Gaming Mode is on and holds this setting for its session, and puts it back when it stops. Stop Gaming Mode first. Nothing was changed.
backendErrors.gmHoldsPlan: Gaming Mode is on and has switched your power plan for its session, and this setting belongs to the power plan. Stop Gaming Mode first, then change it. Nothing was changed.
backendErrors.gmLeftoverHoldsPlan: A Gaming Mode session that didn't finish putting its changes back still holds your power plan, and this setting belongs to the power plan. Finish that session first in Gaming Mode ("Finish the last Gaming Mode session"). Nothing was changed.
backendErrors.gmLeftoverHoldsSetting: A Gaming Mode session that didn't finish putting its changes back holds this setting, and puts it back when it's finished. Finish it first in Gaming Mode ("Finish the last Gaming Mode session"). Nothing was changed.
backendErrors.gmRestoreInFlight: Gaming Mode is putting its changes back right now (if a Windows permission prompt is open, answer or cancel it). Try again when it has finished. Nothing was changed.
backendErrors.planTrialMeasuring: The power plan or one of its settings is being measured by a Trial right now, and this action writes to the same power plan, so Compy won't run it during the measurement. Let the Trial finish, or end it with Restore now in Test, first. Nothing was changed.
backendErrors.planBenchMeasuring: The power plan or one of its settings is being measured by the benchmark right now, and this action writes to the same power plan, so Compy won't run it during the measurement. Let it finish, or cancel it, first. Nothing was changed.
backendErrors.planTrialInterrupted: An earlier Trial start on the power plan or one of its settings was interrupted and isn't resolved yet. This action writes to the same power plan, so Compy won't run it now. Check Test → Applied & history, then try again. Nothing was changed.

careStore.saveFailed: Compy couldn't save this; it'll try again
careStore.saveStopped: Compy couldn't save this; the crash notice may show again
careStore.readFailed: Compy couldn't check for crash notices; it'll try again
careStore.readStopped: Compy couldn't check for crash notices; it'll check again when you open another page

gamingToast.resumedBodyMerged: {{summary}} — stop it from {{room}} when you're done.

booting.readFailed: Couldn't read your hardware just now.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.help: Compy's raw view of your PC. These are the observations the recommendation engine reads to decide what to surface. If a rec you expect doesn't show up — or one you don't expect does — the answer usually lives here.
